name: sluice
tagline: Egress guard: catch leaked secrets before an agent sends them.
description: Scans every outbound agent message — email, social draft, chat reply, a write to a public site — for leaked API keys, tokens, private keys and internal identifiers, then refuses or redacts in place. Catches Anthropic/OpenAI/OpenRouter keys, GitLab/GitHub PATs, AWS keys, Slack/Stripe/Telegram tokens, JWTs/Supabase keys, PEM blocks, entropy-gated key=value assignments and private IPs. Precision-tuned; previews never echo the secret. Pure Python standard library.
